Public REST API surface of eobuwie.com.pl, the MODIVO Group's footwear storefront, served by its Adobe Commerce / Magento 2.4 deployment and self-described at https://eobuwie.com.pl/rest/all/schema?services=all. Covers guest cart and checkout, guest order placement, customer account management, product render info, directory data, gift messages, and eobuwie-specific extensions (My Returns webhook, chatbot order REST API). Mechanically converted from the provider's own Swagger 2.0 document; the verbatim original is in openapi/_original/.
